final_target: int(any(family_true)); multi-label family witnesses retained for diagnostics only.
global_eligibility: Current role, full observed coverage and minimum baseline counts/distincts in each row are additional mandatory AND conditions. None means no extra minimum. Inapplicable or ineligible families are false.
independent_input: Observable event schema only. Neither features, predictions nor private scenario metadata are accepted.
semantic_changes: All families receive canonical endpoints/full prior keys and explicit denominator floors. A1/S2/S4 use35d, N1/N2/A2/A4 use29d, S1/A3 use28d+1h. A2/A4 replace frozen27d baseline; A3 replaces frozen7d-offset baseline. These are V4 definitions, not corrections to V3 bytes.
